title.zh: 實驗室研究什麼？
title.en: What does the lab study?

answer.zh: 實驗室以微流體、生物感測與體外診斷為核心，從檢驗需求出發，研究檢體前處理、分離濃縮、反應、訊號讀取與系統驗證。
answer.en: The lab focuses on microfluidics, biosensing and in vitro diagnostics, from sample preparation and separation to detection, readout and system validation.

title.zh: 什麼是微流體？實驗室如何應用？
title.en: What is microfluidics and how is it used?

answer.zh: 微流體利用微小流道或腔室處理液體、細胞與分子，可用於檢體輸送、混合、分離與反應；實驗室研究其在生醫檢測的應用。
answer.en: Microfluidics controls liquids, cells and molecules in small channels or chambers for sample transport, mixing, separation and reactions. The lab explores biomedical testing applications.

title.zh: 什麼是生物感測與體外診斷？
title.en: What are biosensing and in vitro diagnostics?

answer.zh: 生物感測將生物作用轉換成可讀取的訊號；實驗室結合微流體與感測、訊號讀取，研究體外診斷流程與系統。
answer.en: Biosensing converts biological interactions into measurable signals. The lab integrates microfluidics, sensing and readout for in vitro diagnostic workflows.

title.zh: 呼氣冷凝液研究是什麼？
title.en: What is the exhaled breath condensate study?

answer.zh: 主持人於實驗室成立前參與的研究，將冷凝微流體與親水薄膜整合於口罩，收集呼氣冷凝液以分析代謝物。詳細設計與結果請參考原論文。
answer.en: Before the lab was established, the PI participated in work integrating cooling microfluidics and a hydrophilic film into a mask to collect exhaled breath condensate for metabolite analysis. See the original paper for details.

title.zh: 聲學微流體與痰液處理是什麼？
title.en: What is the acoustic microfluidic sputum study?

answer.zh: 主持人於實驗室成立前參與的研究，利用聲波驅動氣泡產生微流，協助痰液混合與液化，並整合液體輸送及控制。臨床診斷效益仍需相應驗證。
answer.en: Before the lab was established, the PI participated in a study using acoustically driven bubbles to mix and liquefy sputum with integrated fluid handling and control. Clinical diagnostic benefit requires appropriate validation.

title.zh: 有細菌檢測相關研究嗎？
title.en: Is there research on bacterial detection?

answer.zh: 網站介紹主持人於實驗室成立前參與的研究：以濾膜、離心微流體與比色反應偵測水中活菌。若有其他菌種或檢體需求，歡迎討論可行性。
answer.en: The website describes a study the PI participated in before the lab was established: membrane concentration, centrifugal microfluidics and colorimetry for viable bacteria in water. Other organisms and samples require project-specific discussion.

title.zh: Au/SiC 光催化微流體是什麼？
title.en: What is the Au/SiC photocatalytic microfluidics study?

answer.zh: 主持人於實驗室成立前參與的研究，將雷射製備的 Au/SiC 材料與微流道整合，並以模型污染物評估光催化反應。
answer.en: Before the lab was established, the PI participated in research integrating laser-fabricated Au/SiC materials with microchannels and evaluating photocatalysis using a model pollutant.

title.zh: 有核酸、免疫檢測相關研究嗎？
title.en: Is nucleic-acid or immunoassay integration a research topic?

answer.zh: 網站列出的研究方向包含核酸與免疫檢測整合、樣本處理模組化、生物感測與訊號讀取；特定標的與方法需依研究或合作需求討論。
answer.en: The research topics on the site include integrating nucleic-acid and immunoassay testing, modular sample handling, biosensing and readout. Specific targets and methods are discussed per project.

title.zh: 可以用哪些方式製作晶片？
title.en: How are chips and prototypes fabricated?

answer.zh: 網站介紹 CNC 微銑切、晶圓級母模規劃與 3D 列印等方式。實際製程依材料、幾何形狀、尺寸、深度與加工條件評估。
answer.en: The site describes CNC micromilling, wafer-level master mold planning and 3D printing. The process depends on material, geometry, feature size, depth and fabrication conditions.

title.zh: 有 CNC 加工嗎？精度如何？
title.en: Is CNC machining available and what is the feature size?

answer.zh: 網站列有桌上型 CNC 加工，並以 0.1 mm（100 μm）作為微銑切最小特徵線寬參考；實際尺寸、公差與表面品質需依材料、深度、刀具及幾何形狀評估。
answer.en: The site lists desktop CNC machining and gives 0.1 mm (100 μm) as a reference minimum feature width for micromilling. Dimensions, tolerances and surface finish depend on material, depth, tooling and geometry.

title.zh: 可以規劃晶圓級母模嗎？
title.en: Are wafer-level master molds supported?

answer.zh: 合作頁面列有晶圓級母模規劃，20 μm 為特徵線寬參考；實際製作需依光罩、光阻厚度、深度與製程條件確認。
answer.en: The collaboration page describes wafer-level master mold planning, with a reference feature width of 20 μm. Feasibility depends on mask design, resist thickness, depth and process conditions.

title.zh: 有 3D 列印或雷射直寫嗎？
title.en: Are 3D printing and laser direct writing available?

answer.zh: 設備頁列有光固化 3D 列印機與紫外雷射直寫系統，可依結構與材料評估模具、接頭、治具或微結構試作。
answer.en: The instrument page lists a resin 3D printer and UV laser direct-writing system. Molds, connectors, fixtures and microstructure prototypes are evaluated by geometry and material.

title.zh: 可以製作或接合 PDMS 晶片嗎？
title.en: Can you make or bond PDMS chips?

answer.zh: 網站將 PDMS 列為彈性晶片與微結構翻模材料，也介紹氧電漿協助 PDMS 與玻璃接合。幾何、材料和製作可行性依需求討論。
answer.en: The site lists PDMS for elastomeric chips and replication, and oxygen plasma for assisting PDMS–glass bonding. Geometry, materials and feasibility are discussed per project.

title.zh: 可以使用哪些晶片材料？
title.en: Which chip and mold materials are listed?

answer.zh: 合作頁面列有壓克力 PMMA、PDMS、鋁製模具及耐高溫樹脂模具。選材會考量試劑相容性、光學需求、溫度與接合方式。
answer.en: The collaboration page lists PMMA, PDMS, aluminum molds and high-temperature resin molds. Selection considers reagent compatibility, optics, temperature and bonding.

title.zh: 有幫浦、閥件或流體控制嗎？
title.en: Are pumps, valves or fluid controls available?

answer.zh: 網站列有程式控制多通道針筒泵浦；合作頁也介紹依流量、壓力、通道數及操作時序規劃幫浦、閥件與管路整合。
answer.en: The instrument page lists programmable multichannel syringe pumps. Collaboration may include pumps, valves and tubing scoped to flow, pressure, channels and timing.

title.zh: 有哪些顯微鏡與影像設備？
title.en: What microscopy and imaging equipment is listed?

answer.zh: 儀器頁列有倒立式及正立式顯微鏡，分別介紹細胞與晶片觀察、玻片明場觀察等用途；影像擷取配置請依個案確認。
answer.en: The instrument page lists inverted and upright microscopes for applications including cells, chips and bright-field slides. Imaging configurations should be confirmed for each project.

title.zh: 有微生物培養與生物實驗嗎？
title.en: Does the lab conduct microbial culture and biological experiments?

answer.zh: 技術頁介紹微生物培養與檢測，以及生物實驗操作空間。菌種、樣本風險、設備與執行範圍須依實驗室規範及個案確認。
answer.en: The techniques page describes microbial culture, testing and biological laboratory work. Organisms, sample risks, facilities and scope must be confirmed under laboratory procedures.

title.zh: 有細胞培養設施嗎？
title.en: Are cell culture facilities available?

answer.zh: 技術頁介紹共同細胞培養空間，可支援細胞維護與實驗準備；使用與排程依共同空間規範辦理，具體合作範圍另行確認。
answer.en: The techniques page describes a shared cell culture facility for cell maintenance and preparation. Access follows shared-facility rules, and project scope is confirmed separately.

title.zh: 實驗室有哪些儀器？
title.en: What instruments are available?

answer.zh: 網站列出的儀器涵蓋 CNC、3D 列印、顯微鏡、針筒泵浦、氧電漿、生物列印及生物實驗設備。實際可使用的配置與時程請洽詢。
answer.en: Listed instruments include CNC, 3D printing, microscopes, syringe pumps, oxygen plasma, bioprinting and biological laboratory equipment. Confirm configurations and availability with the lab.

title.zh: 可以協助設計微流體晶片嗎？
title.en: Can the lab help design a microfluidic chip?

answer.zh: 合作頁介紹依樣本、試劑與操作需求規劃流道、混合、分離或反應結構，並可討論材料、製作和初步測試。
answer.en: The collaboration page describes planning channels, mixing, separation and reaction structures around samples, reagents and operating needs, with materials, fabrication and testing discussed per project.

title.zh: 已經有圖面，可以委託加工嗎？
title.en: Can you fabricate from an existing design?

answer.zh: 網站列有圖面與規格明確的簡單加工項目。請提供材料、尺寸、線寬、深度、數量及圖面，以便討論製作可行性。
answer.en: The site lists defined fabrication based on existing drawings and specifications. Share the material, dimensions, feature width, depth, quantity and drawings for a feasibility discussion.

title.zh: 可以討論器官晶片嗎？
title.en: Can we discuss organ-on-chip prototypes?

answer.zh: 合作頁列有器官晶片原型的培養腔室、灌流與連接介面設計；細胞模型和功能驗證範圍依合作需求另行界定。
answer.en: The collaboration page includes culture chambers, perfusion and interfaces for organ-on-chip prototypes. Cell models and functional validation are scoped separately.

title.zh: 可以整合幫浦與控制系統嗎？
title.en: Can fluid handling and controls be integrated?

answer.zh: 合作頁介紹依流量、壓力、通道數及操作時序，規劃幫浦、閥件、管路接頭與控制介面。具體配置依合作需求設計。
answer.en: The collaboration page describes pumps, valves, tubing and controls scoped around flow, pressure, channels and timing. Configurations are project-specific.

title.zh: 可以協助原型測試嗎？
title.en: Can prototypes be tested?

answer.zh: 合作頁列有依範圍討論流動、混合、漏液及初步生物實驗測試；測試樣本、方法與交付結果於立案前確認。
answer.en: The collaboration page describes flow, mixing, leakage and preliminary biological tests within an agreed scope. Samples, methods and deliverables are confirmed before the project.

title.zh: 洽談合作前需要準備什麼？
title.en: What should I prepare for a project inquiry?

answer.zh: 建議提供用途、樣本與試劑、尺寸／線寬／深度、材料、數量、圖面準備狀態、期望功能及預計時程。尚未確定的項目可以先說明。
answer.en: Please share the application, samples and reagents, dimensions and feature width/depth, material, quantity, drawing status, desired functions and timeline. Unknown items can be discussed.

title.zh: 合作費用如何計算？
title.en: How are collaboration fees determined?

answer.zh: 合作頁說明：圖面與規格明確的簡單加工，參考數千元至數萬元起；設計、試作、整合或生物測試依範圍另行報價，實際費用以正式報價及校方程序為準。
answer.en: The collaboration page gives several thousand to tens of thousands of NTD as a starting reference for straightforward fabrication with defined drawings. Design, prototyping, integration and biological testing are quoted separately; formal quotations and university procedures govern.

title.zh: 合作成果與專利如何約定？
title.en: How are intellectual property and ownership handled?

answer.zh: 合作成果可依陽明交大相關規定與契約，洽議授權、共有或技術移轉等安排；具體權利依經費來源、貢獻及校方審核，於契約確認。
answer.en: Licensing, joint ownership or technology transfer may be negotiated under NYCU rules and the agreement. Rights depend on funding, contributions and university review, and are specified in the contract.

title.zh: 如何加入實驗室或詢問專題？
title.en: How can I join the lab or inquire about a project?

answer.zh: 請透過聯絡表單選擇加入實驗室或學生專題，簡述目前就讀單位、背景、研究興趣與希望參與的時間。名額與安排請直接洽詢。
answer.en: Select joining the lab or student project in the contact form and describe your institution, background, research interests and intended timeframe. Contact the lab about availability.

title.zh: 沒有工程或程式背景可以加入嗎？
title.en: Can I join without engineering or programming experience?

answer.zh: 網站歡迎醫技、生科、生醫與相關背景學生洽詢。晶片設計、基礎製程、影像分析及程式工具可透過研究訓練循序學習；請與老師討論適合的研究方向。
answer.en: Students from medical laboratory science, biotechnology, biomedical science and related fields are welcome to inquire. Chip design, fabrication, imaging and programming can be developed during training.

title.zh: 加入後會學到哪些技術？
title.en: What skills can students learn?

answer.zh: 依研究題目，可能接觸微流體設計、CNC 或 3D 列印、晶片測試、生物感測、訊號量測、影像處理、資料分析與科學寫作。
answer.en: Depending on the project, training may include microfluidic design, CNC or 3D printing, chip testing, biosensing, signal measurement, imaging, data analysis and scientific writing.

title.zh: 碩士班的研究與畢業路徑如何規劃？
title.en: What is the master’s training and graduation pathway?

answer.zh: 研究規劃從研究問題、原型建立與測試，進入參數最佳化、整合驗證及論文準備；碩士論文研究以達到具備期刊投稿水準為基本要求。兩年為研究規劃目標，畢業仍須符合校系規定並依研究進度調整。
answer.en: The research plan progresses from a research question and prototypes through optimization, validation and thesis preparation; master’s thesis research is expected to reach a standard suitable for journal submission. Two years is a planning goal; graduation follows university and department rules and actual progress.

title.zh: 每位學生都需要做 AI 嗎？
title.en: Is AI required for every project?

answer.zh: 網站說明是否使用 AI 或深度學習，取決於研究問題、資料量與驗證方式；學生的技術訓練依專題內容安排。
answer.en: The student FAQ states that AI or deep-learning use depends on the research question, available data and validation needs. Training is tailored to the project.

title.zh: 畢業後有哪些方向？
title.en: What are possible career paths?

answer.zh: 網站介紹的方向包含體外診斷與醫材研發、生物感測和微流體產業、研究機構及博士進修；實際機會依個人技能與職缺條件而定。
answer.en: The website describes possible paths in IVD and medical-device R&D, biosensing, microfluidics, research institutes and doctoral study. Opportunities depend on individual skills and job requirements.

title.zh: 在哪裡看論文與研究成果？
title.en: Where can I find publications and research?

answer.zh: 網站的著作區列出主持人相關論文與 DOI；首頁研究故事也整理四項研究的背景、圖示與原始論文。
answer.en: The publications section lists the PI’s papers and DOI links. The research stories introduce four studies with background, figures and links to the original papers.

title.zh: 主持人是誰？研究背景是什麼？
title.en: Who is the principal investigator?

answer.zh: 百洑傳息實驗室由陽明交通大學醫學生物技術暨檢驗學系張鈞豪助理教授主持，研究專長包含微流體、生物感測及體外診斷相關技術。
answer.en: Bioflumen & Xensor Lab is led by Assistant Professor Chun-Hao Chang at NYCU’s Department of Biotechnology and Laboratory Science in Medicine, with expertise in microfluidics, biosensing and diagnostics.

title.zh: 如何聯絡實驗室？
title.en: How can I contact the lab?

answer.zh: 您可使用網站聯絡表單，或來信 jimhao@nycu.edu.tw；請簡述您的背景、需求與希望討論的內容。
answer.en: Use the website contact form or email jimhao@nycu.edu.tw. Please briefly introduce your background, request and discussion topic.

title.zh: 實驗室在哪裡？
title.en: Where is the lab located?

answer.zh: 實驗室位於國立陽明交通大學陽明校區生醫工程館 223 室，地址為 112 臺北市北投區立農街二段 155 號。到訪前建議先聯絡確認。
answer.en: The lab is in Room 223, Biomedical Engineering Building, NYCU Yangming Campus, No. 155, Sec. 2, Li-Nong Street, Beitou District, Taipei 112, Taiwan. Please contact the lab before visiting.

title.zh: 課程、線上工具與學習資源在哪裡？
title.en: Where are teaching resources and online tools?

answer.zh: 網站的線上資源頁收錄教學工具、外部學習資源與下載項目，可依用途搜尋。
answer.en: The Online Resources page contains teaching tools, external learning materials and downloads, with search by purpose.

title.zh: 如何查看最新消息和實驗室生活？
title.en: Where are lab news and activities?

answer.zh: 您可以查看實驗室最新消息與生活剪影頁面，了解已公開的活動資訊。
answer.en: Visit the lab news and moments pages for published updates and activities.

title.zh: 還有碩士生或專題生名額嗎？
title.en: Are there openings for master’s or undergraduate students?

answer.zh: 名額會隨學年度與研究安排變動，網站未列即時名額。請提供就讀系所、年級、感興趣的方向及預計加入時間，直接聯絡老師確認。
answer.en: Openings vary by academic year and project, and current availability is not listed on the site. Contact the PI with your program, year, interests and intended start date.

title.zh: 第一次聯絡或面談要準備什麼？
title.en: What should I prepare for an initial inquiry or meeting?

answer.zh: 可以先了解研究方向，並準備簡短自我介紹、就讀背景、相關課程或專題經驗、研究興趣及可參與時間。是否需要履歷、成績單或其他資料，請事先向老師確認。
answer.en: Review the research areas and prepare a brief introduction, academic background, relevant courses or projects, interests and availability. Ask the PI in advance whether a CV, transcript or other materials are needed.

title.zh: 可以先參觀實驗室或和學生聊聊嗎？
title.en: Can I visit the lab or speak with current students?

answer.zh: 如想參觀或了解研究環境，可先透過聯絡表單詢問，並提供身分與方便時間；參觀與交流方式依實驗室安排確認。
answer.en: To request a visit or learn about the research environment, contact the lab with your background and availability. The visit and any student conversation depend on lab arrangements.

title.zh: 沒有做過專題或實驗，也可以詢問加入嗎？
title.en: Can I inquire without prior project or lab experience?

answer.zh: 可以先說明目前的課程背景、研究興趣與可參與時間。網站介紹的基礎訓練包含實驗安全、研究紀錄及晶片或影像工具入門；實際是否錄取及訓練安排需與老師討論。
answer.en: You may inquire with your coursework, interests and availability. The website describes orientation in safety, documentation and introductory chip or imaging tools; admission and the actual training plan are discussed with the PI.

title.zh: 大學生可以做專題嗎？什麼時候開始？
title.en: Can undergraduates do a research project, and when?

answer.zh: 網站提供學生專題洽詢入口。請說明目前年級、課程背景、感興趣的研究及預計投入時間；專題生名額、開始時間與工作安排請直接確認。
answer.en: The website accepts undergraduate project inquiries. Share your year, coursework, research interests and expected availability; confirm openings, start dates and responsibilities with the lab.

title.zh: 外系或跨領域背景可以申請嗎？
title.en: Can students from another department or field inquire?

answer.zh: 網站歡迎醫技、生科、生醫及相關領域學生洽詢，也介紹醫學工程背景的跨領域共同指導。實際申請、指導及系所資格請依個人情況確認。
answer.en: Students from medical laboratory science, biotechnology, biomedical science and related fields are welcome to inquire. The website also describes co-supervision for biomedical engineering students; program eligibility and arrangements require confirmation.

title.zh: 入學前暑假需要進實驗室嗎？
title.en: Is pre-enrollment summer training required?

answer.zh: 網站目前規劃暑假約 2–3 週的基礎設備與實驗流程訓練，內容包含安全、紀錄及工具入門。實際日期、參與方式和是否需要提前進實驗室，請與老師確認。
answer.en: The website describes a planned 2–3 week summer orientation in equipment and laboratory workflows, including safety, records and introductory tools. Confirm dates, participation and any pre-enrollment expectations with the PI.

title.zh: 加入前建議先學什麼？
title.en: What can I study before joining?

answer.zh: 可先認識實驗室的微流體、生物感測與體外診斷方向，練習閱讀相關論文及整理實驗紀錄。是否需要先修特定課程或工具，請與老師依研究方向討論。
answer.en: You can start with the lab’s microfluidics, biosensing and IVD topics and practice reading papers and keeping research notes. Discuss any project-specific courses or tools with the PI.

title.zh: 研究題目是自己選，還是老師安排？
title.en: How is a research topic selected?

answer.zh: 網站的碩士路徑從研究問題與檢測目標建立開始。題目如何形成、能否結合自己的興趣或既有計畫，請在面談時與老師討論；網站未列固定分配方式。
answer.en: The master’s roadmap begins with defining a research question and target. Discuss topic selection, personal interests and existing projects with the PI; the site does not specify a fixed allocation process.

title.zh: 研究是一人一題，還是團隊合作？
title.en: Are projects individual or team-based?

answer.zh: 研究題目、分工與合作方式會依專題內容及人員安排討論。網站介紹了團隊協作與跨領域研究訓練；個別題目是否共同進行，請向老師確認。
answer.en: Topic ownership, responsibilities and collaboration depend on the project and team. The website describes teamwork and interdisciplinary training; confirm the arrangement for a particular project with the PI.

title.zh: 老師會怎麼指導？會有學長姐帶嗎？
title.en: How does supervision work? Will senior students help?

answer.zh: 網站介紹的訓練包含研究設計、實驗操作、紀錄與討論。老師、學長姐及合作夥伴的具體指導與分工方式，請在面談時直接確認。
answer.en: The website describes training in research design, laboratory work, documentation and discussion. Ask the PI about the specific roles of faculty, senior students and collaborators.

title.zh: 可以跨領域共同指導或合作嗎？
title.en: Is interdisciplinary co-supervision possible?

answer.zh: 網站介紹醫學工程背景學生可與原指導老師及本實驗室討論共同指導或專題合作，結合感測、電子、機構、材料與製程等專長；正式安排與資格須由相關老師及系所確認。
answer.en: The website describes a possible co-supervision or project collaboration model for biomedical engineering students, combining sensing, electronics, mechanics, materials or fabrication. The faculty and programs must confirm eligibility and formal arrangements.

title.zh: 實驗不順利或題目不適合，可以調整嗎？
title.en: Can a project be adjusted if experiments do not work?

answer.zh: 網站的培訓路徑包含參數最佳化、對照組與結果限制檢討。若實驗遇到瓶頸，可整理紀錄、已嘗試的方法與問題，和老師討論下一步；題目調整需依研究進度確認。
answer.en: The roadmap includes parameter optimization, controls and review of limitations. If you encounter a problem, bring your records, attempted approaches and questions to the PI; topic changes depend on research progress.

title.zh: 會同時做生物實驗和晶片製作嗎？
title.en: Will I work on both biological experiments and chips?

answer.zh: 網站介紹的訓練包含檢驗流程、晶片設計製作、生物感測與系統驗證。實際接觸哪些技術、各部分投入時間，會依研究題目與分工而定。
answer.en: The website describes training in laboratory workflows, chip design and fabrication, biosensing and validation. The techniques and time spent on each depend on the project and responsibilities.

title.zh: 進實驗室會有安全訓練嗎？
title.en: Is safety training included?

answer.zh: 學生 FAQ 將實驗安全列入預計的基礎訓練；具體課程、設備操作與樣本處理要求，須依實驗室及校方規範確認。涉及人體研究或可識別檢體時，依適用規定辦理審查。
answer.en: The student FAQ includes laboratory safety in the planned orientation. Confirm specific training, equipment and sample-handling requirements under lab and university procedures. Human research and identifiable specimens follow applicable review requirements.

title.zh: 多久開一次 meeting？怎麼報告？
title.en: How often are lab meetings held, and what is presented?

answer.zh: 實驗室會議原則上安排在每週一上午，約 2 小時。如有額外的研究問題需要討論，可以再與 PI 另約時間；報告主題及形式可依需要與老師確認。
answer.en: Lab meetings are generally held on Monday mornings and last about two hours. Students can arrange additional time with the PI when research questions need further discussion; presentation topics and formats can be confirmed with the PI.

title.zh: 報告和論文閱讀需要全英文嗎？
title.en: Are presentations and paper discussions entirely in English?

answer.zh: 網站將中英文簡報、文獻閱讀及論文寫作列為研究訓練。會議實際使用的語言、報告形式與學習安排，請直接詢問老師。
answer.en: The website lists bilingual presentations, literature reading and scientific writing as part of training. Ask the PI about the language, format and support used in actual meetings.

title.zh: 實驗室的作息與請假方式是什麼？
title.en: What are the lab’s expected hours and leave arrangements?

answer.zh: 實驗室原則上以 10:00–18:00 為在實驗室的時段，主要配合學校公務與日常研究安排。管理採高信任方式，不強迫每位同學準時抵達，但希望大家培養規律作息。如有家庭事務、病假、特殊節日或出國安排，可直接向 PI 請假；多數情況會彈性核准。
answer.en: The general expected time in the lab is 10:00–18:00, coordinated with university duties and research activities. The lab operates on trust: exact arrival at 10:00 is not enforced, while students are encouraged to develop a regular routine. For family matters, illness, special occasions or travel, students can request leave directly from the PI; requests are usually accommodated flexibly.

title.zh: 週末、國定假日或晚上要進實驗室嗎？
title.en: Are evenings, weekends or holidays required?

answer.zh: 實驗室原則上的在室時段為 10:00–18:00，採高信任管理。週末、假日或晚間是否需要配合實驗，請依研究安排與 PI 討論；如有家庭事務、病假、特殊節日或出國安排，也可直接向 PI 請假，多數情況會彈性核准。
answer.en: The general expected time in the lab is 10:00–18:00 under a trust-based arrangement. Discuss any weekend, holiday or evening experimental needs with the PI. For family matters, illness, special occasions or travel, students may request leave directly; requests are usually accommodated flexibly.

title.zh: 碩一修課和研究進度怎麼安排？
title.en: How can first-year coursework and research be balanced?

answer.zh: 網站的碩士規劃以碩一上建立研究目標與基本能力、碩一下建立方法及原型為方向。實際修課、進實驗室時間及研究進度，請依系所規定與老師討論。
answer.en: The roadmap places initial goal-setting and basic skills in the first semester, followed by methods and prototypes in the second. Discuss the actual coursework, lab time and research plan under your program’s requirements.

title.zh: 需要讀多少篇論文？如何開始？
title.en: How much literature reading is expected?

answer.zh: 網站將文獻搜尋與判讀列入學生訓練，也提供研究成果與論文連結。閱讀篇數、討論方式及起始文獻，請依題目與老師確認。
answer.en: The website includes literature search and appraisal in student training and links to research publications. Ask the PI about the expected reading, discussion format and starting papers for your topic.

title.zh: 研究生或專題生有薪資、獎學金或補助嗎？
title.en: What stipend or scholarship support is available?

answer.zh: 系上有依規定發放的普發獎學金；實驗室的獎助則依國科會計畫預算彈性調整，適用對象及實際金額請向老師或系上確認。我們也鼓勵同學積極爭取校外獎學金。主持人就讀博士班期間，曾累計獲得超過新臺幣 50 萬元的業界獎學金；各項獎學金仍須依資格與評選結果申請。
answer.en: The department offers generally available scholarships under its applicable rules. Additional lab support may vary with the National Science and Technology Council (NSTC) project budget; please confirm eligibility and the actual amount with the PI or department. Students are encouraged to apply for external scholarships. During his doctoral studies, the PI received more than NT$500,000 in industry scholarships in total; each award depends on its own eligibility and selection process.

title.zh: 可以打工或到企業實習嗎？
title.en: Can students take a part-time job or industry internship?

answer.zh: 如果打工或實習機會不影響研究工作，同學可先與 PI 討論，由 PI 視研究進度、工作或實習安排及相關規定評估同意。我們也鼓勵同學積極爭取校外獎學金。
answer.en: Students may discuss part-time work or an internship with the PI in advance. The PI may approve it depending on research progress, the proposed schedule and applicable rules, provided it does not interfere with research. Students are also encouraged to pursue external scholarships.

title.zh: 研究耗材、軟體或設備需要自己付費嗎？
title.en: Will students need to pay for materials, software or equipment?

answer.zh: 網站尚未公布統一的個人支出或研究費用安排。關於耗材、軟體授權、設備使用及自備物品，請在加入或購買前向老師確認。
answer.en: The website does not state a general policy on personal research expenses. Ask the PI about consumables, software licenses, equipment access and personal supplies before joining or purchasing.

title.zh: 有機會參加研討會或投稿嗎？
title.en: Are there opportunities to attend conferences or publish?

answer.zh: 碩士培訓路徑包含整理研討會資料；參與機會與經費依研究成果、計畫及指導安排確認。論文投稿依個人需求與 PI 討論，有交換、留學或就業規劃者，強烈建議將研究成果投稿期刊。
answer.en: The master’s roadmap includes preparing conference materials; participation and funding depend on results, projects and supervision. Journal submission is discussed with the PI based on individual goals and is strongly encouraged for students planning an exchange, further study abroad or employment.

title.zh: 畢業需要符合哪些規定？
title.en: What are the graduation requirements?

answer.zh: 實驗室以碩士論文研究達到具備期刊投稿水準為基本要求；實際是否投稿與發表，依個人需求與 PI 討論。網站以兩年為研究規劃目標，畢業仍須符合所屬系所的修課、學分、論文及審查規定，並依研究進度調整。
answer.en: The lab expects master’s thesis research to reach a standard suitable for journal submission; actual submission and publication are discussed with the PI according to the student’s goals. Two years is a planning goal. Graduation also requires the applicable program’s coursework, credits, thesis and examination requirements and depends on research progress.

title.zh: 畢業一定要投稿或發表期刊論文嗎？
title.en: Is a journal submission or publication required for graduation?

answer.zh: 碩士論文的研究內容以達到具備期刊投稿水準為基本要求；實際投稿與發表依個人需求與 PI 討論安排。有交換、留學或就業需求的同學，強烈建議將研究成果投稿期刊。AI 工具可協助文獻整理、圖表及文字撰寫，但研究原創性、資料可靠度、學術倫理與期刊審查仍須嚴謹把關；畢業也須符合系所規定。
answer.en: The master’s thesis research is expected to reach a standard suitable for journal submission. Actual submission and publication are arranged with the PI according to each student’s goals. Students planning an exchange, further study abroad or employment are strongly encouraged to submit their work to a journal. AI can assist with literature review, figures and writing, while research originality, reliable data, academic integrity and journal review remain essential. Program graduation requirements also apply.

title.zh: 醫技背景或醫檢師經驗對研究有幫助嗎？
title.en: How does a medical laboratory science background contribute?

answer.zh: 網站指出醫技背景可運用在檢體處理、檢驗流程、品質控制與臨床需求的理解，再結合微流體、生物感測及系統設計。實際研究訓練依題目安排。
answer.en: The website describes how medical laboratory knowledge supports sample handling, laboratory workflows, quality control and clinical requirements alongside microfluidics, biosensing and system design. Training depends on the project.

title.zh: 想念碩士班，報考與指導老師怎麼安排？
title.en: How do graduate admissions and finding an advisor work?

answer.zh: 可先了解所屬系所的招生簡章、報考資格與時程，並向老師詢問研究方向及指導安排。實際錄取、報名與共同指導程序，以當年度系所公告為準。
answer.en: Review your prospective program’s admissions notice, eligibility and schedule, then contact the PI about research and supervision. Admissions and co-supervision procedures follow the program’s current official announcements.

title.zh: 可以申請校外或業界獎學金嗎？
title.en: Can I apply for external or industry scholarships?

answer.zh: 我們鼓勵同學積極爭取校外獎學金，並依各獎項的資格、時程與研究成果準備申請。主持人就讀博士班期間，曾累計獲得超過新臺幣 50 萬元的業界獎學金；此為個人經驗，各項獎學金是否獲得仍取決於申請資格與評選結果。
answer.en: Students are encouraged to pursue external scholarships and prepare applications according to each award’s eligibility, deadlines and research requirements. During his doctoral studies, the PI received more than NT$500,000 in industry scholarships in total. This is a personal example; awards depend on individual eligibility and selection.
